summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish an expedited 30-day approval process for blood centers seeking to add an apheresis collection device to an existing biologics license at a new location, provided certain safety and accreditation criteria are met.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to expedite the approval process for blood centers to add apheresis collection devices, which could increase the availability of blood products. This directly relates to the infrastructure and efficiency of healthcare services, making it easier for private and public entities to provide these services.
